name: PAXgene Blood RNA Tube
definition: A blood collection tube that uses proprietary reagents for whole blood collection and stabilization prior to isolation of cellular RNA.

name: Thermo Fisher Tempus tube
definition: A proprietary blood collection tube for stabilization and isolation of total RNA from whole blood for gene expression analysis. When blood is drawn into the tube and mixed with the proprietary stabilizing reagent, lysis occurs almost immediately. The stabilizing reagent inactivates cellular RNases and selectively precipitates RNA, with genomic DNA and proteins remaining in solution.

name: RNAlater
definition: Trade name for an aqueous, non-toxic tissue storage reagent that rapidly permeates tissues to stabilize and protect cellular RNA.

name: Cell culture
definition: General term referring to the maintenance of cell strains or lines in the laboratory.
